Dhar buuxa oo qof walba u baahan yahay wuxuu u baahan yahay 4 boorsooyin dharka maaskaro kasta + 6 boorsooyin dharka poncho kasta + 7 boorsooyin dharka vest kasta + 14 boorsooyin dharka laba kabaha yar kasta + 16 boorsooyin dharka laba gacmo kasta = <<4+6+7+14+16=47>>47 boorsooyin dharka.
Sidaas darteed si ay u dhaqdo dharka carruurteeda oo dhan, waxay u baahan tahay 2*47 = <<2*47=94>>94 boorsooyin dharka.
